summary: Small industrial-estate car park with no homes nearby, but busy with parked vehicles.

best_section.where: North end of the car park off Meiers Road, by the tree line

drivers.seclusion: Workshops, retail and industrial sheds all round; only dwelling is a detached house 52 m away across buildings.
drivers.access_and_room: Open entry from the road on the south side; many vehicles parked, so room for a van is limited but bays at the north end look usable.
drivers.traffic: Arterial road to the east; the car park is set back behind buildings.
drivers.convention: Looks like a business or customer car park; vehicles are present, no camping seen.

flags: Looks like a business car park; staff may notice a van
Car park is crowded with vehicles in imagery
Arterial road noise to the east
sun_shade: Trees shade the north-east edge; open to sun otherwise, with buildings shading the west side in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is private or customer-only
